items.title: County Government Reportedly Paid $1 Million to Cyber Extortion Group
items.description: The alleged victim, believed to be a small Ohio county, reportedly paid the extortion group to prevent the public release of sensitive stolen data. The post County Government Reportedly Paid $1 Million to Cyber Extortion Group appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Hidden backdoor in Tenda router firmware grants admin access
items.description: A hidden authentication backdoor has been found in multiple Tenda router firmware versions, potentially allowing an attacker to gain administrative access to the device's web management panel. [...]

items.title: Critical Gitea Flaw Under Active Exploitation, Researchers Warn
items.description: Attackers are exploiting the critical Gitea vulnerability CVE-2026-20896 to bypass authentication with a single HTTP header and access vulnerable repositories and secrets. The post Critical Gitea Flaw Under Active Exploitation, Researchers Warn appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: RedWing MaaS Packages Android Bank Fraud as a Telegram Rental Service
items.description: A new Android malware operation called RedWing is being rented out on Telegram as a ready-made bank-fraud service. It lets even low-skill criminals take over a victim's phone, steal their banking logins, and capture the one-time codes that protect their accounts. Zimperium's zLabs, which found the operation, says it looks like a new variant of Oblivion, a $300-a-month rent-a-malware tool

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in GCP Dialogflow Allows Attackers to Inject Malicious Code
items.description: A critical vulnerability in Google Cloud Platform’s Dialogflow CX that lets attackers inject persistent malicious code into an organization’s AI-powered chatbot pipeline. The flaw, dubbed “Rogue Agent,” disclosed by Varonis Threat Labs, could silently exfiltrate conversations and enable large-scale phishing campaigns, requiring only a single edit permission to trigger. The exploit abused…

items.title: Rogue Agent Flaw Could Have Let Attackers Hijack Google Dialogflow CX Chatbots
items.description: A critical flaw in Google's Dialogflow CX could have let an attacker with edit rights on one Code Block-enabled agent compromise other Code Block-enabled agents in the same Google Cloud project. From there, they could read live conversations, steal the data users shared, and make the bots send attacker-written messages, including requests to re-enter a password. items.title: 'GitLost' Flaw Leaks Private Data From GitHub's Agentic Workflows
items.description: The flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker to craft a GitHub Issue in an org's public repository and then silently pull data from its private repos, too.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-31121: Oracle
items.description: A CVSS score 7.5 AV:L/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Xiaobye(@xiaobye_tw) of DEVCORE Research Team' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-07-07, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-11-04 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.

items.title: 'BusySnake' Infostealer Slithers Into Critical Infrastructure Networks
